customers.description: Order-side customer records: one row per order placed. The same person can appear under several customer_id values, so customer_id is not a person identifier. Count real customers with customer_unique_id.
customers.db_comment: Order-side customer records; one row per order. customer_unique_id identifies the actual customer (96,096 distinct across 99,441 rows).
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX customers_pkey ON public.customers USING btree (customer_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_customers_unique_id ON public.customers USING btree (customer_unique_id)

customer_id.description: Primary key. Customer record attached to one order; referenced by orders.customer_id. 99,441 distinct values.

customer_unique_id.description: Identifier of the actual customer (person). Repeats across orders from the same person: 96,096 distinct values across 99,441 rows. Use COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) for customer counts.

customer_zip_code_prefix.db_comment: First digits of the CEP postal code. Source stores it as an integer, so leading zeros are lost (e.g. 1037 means 01037).
customer_zip_code_prefix.description: First digits of the customer's CEP postal code. The source stores it as an integer, so leading zeros are lost (e.g. 1037 means 01037). Do not zero-pad silently.

customer_city.description: Customer city name in Portuguese, lowercase in the source (e.g. 'sao paulo').

customer_state.description: Customer state as a 2-letter Brazilian UF code (e.g. SP, RJ). 27 distinct values.

order_items.description: Order line items (112,650 rows). Grain is one row per unit: buying 3 units of a product creates 3 rows with order_item_id 1..3. Quantity is a count of rows, not a column. Price and freight are per-unit monetary values in BRL.
order_items.db_comment: Order line items: quantity is represented by one row per unit (order_item_id). price is item value; freight_value is the shipping cost allocated to the item.
indexes: CREATE INDEX idx_order_items_product ON public.order_items USING btree (product_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_order_items_seller ON public.order_items USING btree (seller_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX order_items_pkey ON public.order_items USING btree (order_id, order_item_id)

order_id.description: Foreign key to orders.order_id; part of the composite primary key (order_id, order_item_id).

order_item_id.description: Sequence number of the unit within the order (1 to 21). Part of the composite primary key.

seller_id.db_comment: FK to sellers deferred until the sellers table is imported; all values verified against the source sellers CSV.
seller_id.description: Seller that fulfilled this item. All values verified against the source sellers CSV, but the FK is deferred until the sellers table is imported.

shipping_limit_date.description: Deadline for the seller to hand the item to the carrier.

price.description: Merchandise value of one unit in BRL, numeric(10,2). Excludes freight. SUM(price) is gross item value — NOT net revenue (refunds are not observable in this dataset).

freight_value.description: Shipping value allocated to this item in BRL, numeric(10,2). SUM(freight_value) gives total freight charged.

order_payments.description: Payment transactions (103,886 rows). An order can have multiple payment rows (e.g. voucher plus credit card); sum payment_value per order for the total paid. Exactly one order has no payment row.
order_payments.db_comment: Payment transactions per order (order_id + payment_sequential). payment_value includes freight; one order in the dataset has no payment row.
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX order_payments_pkey ON public.order_payments USING btree (order_id, payment_sequential)

order_id.description: Foreign key to orders.order_id; part of the composite primary key (order_id, payment_sequential).

payment_sequential.description: Sequence number of the payment transaction within the order. Part of the composite primary key.

payment_type.description: One of: credit_card, boleto, debit_card, voucher, not_defined.

payment_installments.description: Number of installments chosen for the payment (observed range 0 to 24).

payment_value.description: Transaction value in BRL, numeric(10,2). Includes freight. SUM over an order's rows equals the total paid for that order.

order_reviews.description: Customer reviews (99,224 rows). Primary key is (review_id, order_id) because review_id alone repeats across orders (1,603 rows share a review_id). Scores are 1-5; comment text is mostly NULL.
order_reviews.db_comment: One row per review; PK (review_id, order_id) because review_id alone repeats across orders. review_score is 1-5. Comment title/message are mostly NULL.
indexes: CREATE INDEX idx_order_reviews_order ON public.order_reviews USING btree (order_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX order_reviews_pkey ON public.order_reviews USING btree (review_id, order_id)

review_id.description: Review identifier. NOT unique on its own — the same review can appear for multiple orders. Part of the composite primary key.

order_id.description: Foreign key to orders.order_id; part of the composite primary key. An order may have more than one review.

review_score.description: Review score from 1 to 5 stars (CHECK constraint enforced).

review_comment_title.description: Optional review title in Portuguese. NULL for 87,656 rows.

review_comment_message.description: Optional review message in Portuguese. NULL for 58,247 rows.

review_creation_date.description: Date the review was created (time component is midnight).

review_answer_timestamp.description: Timestamp when the review was answered/processed.

orders.description: One row per order with lifecycle timestamps and a final status snapshot. Central table joining customers, order_items, order_payments and order_reviews. Purchase timestamps range from 2016-09-04 to 2018-10-17.
orders.db_comment: One row per order with lifecycle timestamps. order_status: approved, canceled, created, delivered, invoiced, processing, shipped, unavailable.
indexes: CREATE INDEX idx_orders_customer_id ON public.orders USING btree (customer_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_orders_purchase_ts ON public.orders USING btree (order_purchase_timestamp)
CREATE INDEX idx_orders_status ON public.orders USING btree (order_status)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX orders_pkey ON public.orders USING btree (order_id)

order_id.description: Primary key. Unique order identifier (32-char hex).

customer_id.description: Foreign key to customers.customer_id. Identifies the order-side customer record, not necessarily a unique person.

order_status.description: Final status snapshot. One of: approved, canceled, created, delivered, invoiced, processing, shipped, unavailable. 'canceled' (625 orders) and 'unavailable' (609 orders) are distinct outcomes; 96,478 orders are delivered.

order_purchase_timestamp.description: When the order was placed. Never NULL. Anchor timestamp for time-series analysis.

order_approved_at.description: When the order was approved (payment confirmation). NULL for 160 orders that were never approved.

order_delivered_carrier_date.description: When the order was handed to the carrier. NULL for 1,783 orders.

order_delivered_customer_date.description: When the customer received the order. NULL for 2,965 orders, including 8 orders whose status is 'delivered'.

order_estimated_delivery_date.description: Delivery date promised to the customer at purchase time. Never NULL. Useful for on-time-delivery analysis.

product_category_translation.description: Lookup table mapping Portuguese category names to English (71 rows). Incomplete: the categories 'pc_gamer' and 'portateis_cozinha_e_preparadores_de_alimentos' used by 13 products are missing. Always LEFT JOIN; never assume a translation exists.
product_category_translation.db_comment: Portuguese-to-English category lookup (71 rows). Incomplete: pc_gamer and portateis_cozinha_e_preparadores_de_alimentos are missing; join with LEFT JOIN.
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX product_category_translation_pkey ON public.product_category_translation USING btree (product_category_name)

product_category_name.description: Primary key. Portuguese category name exactly as used in products.product_category_name.

products.description: One row per product (32,951). Category and physical attributes are nullable. Column names intentionally keep the source CSV's 'lenght' misspelling.
products.db_comment: One row per product. Category and attribute columns are nullable; column names keep the source spelling (e.g. product_name_lenght).
indexes: CREATE INDEX idx_products_category ON public.products USING btree (product_category_name)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX products_pkey ON public.products USING btree (product_id)

product_id.description: Primary key. Unique product identifier (32-char hex).

product_category_name.db_comment: No enforced FK: 13 products reference categories missing from product_category_translation. 610 products have NULL category.
product_category_name.description: Portuguese category name. NULL for 610 products; 13 products use categories absent from product_category_translation. No enforced foreign key — join with LEFT JOIN.

product_name_lenght.description: Number of characters in the product name (source spelling: 'lenght'). NULL for 610 products.

product_description_lenght.description: Number of characters in the product description (source spelling: 'lenght'). NULL for 610 products.

product_photos_qty.description: Number of product photos on the listing. NULL for 610 products.

product_weight_g.description: Product weight in grams. NULL for 2 products.

product_length_cm.description: Product length in centimeters. NULL for 2 products.

product_height_cm.description: Product height in centimeters. NULL for 2 products.

product_width_cm.description: Product width in centimeters. NULL for 2 products.
